title: specification-capture input contract
description: Input contract for the specification-capture skill. The skill captures non-goals, failure modes, and interface contracts for an issue and persists them to the decision journal. See plugins/flow/skills/specification-capture/SKILL.md for the skill's full process.

issueContext.description: The issue context the skill parses for prior specification statements.

body.description: The full issue body. The skill scans this for non-goals/failure-modes/interface-contracts cues.

comments.description: All comments on the issue in chronological order.

journalPath.description: Path to the decision journal file where the captured specification is persisted. Typically `.decisions/issue-{N}.md`.

invocationReason.description: Which command invoked the skill. Used to scope which elements the skill focuses on (start needs all three; design needs non-goals + interface contracts; brainstorm needs non-goals only).
